negative_tests: promotion missing any required PASS must fail
unknown skill requested for packaging must fail
self-attested comparative evidence must not become Evidence Level 5
structural external-comparison readiness must not authorize a leadership or superiority claim

comparative_evidence.level_5_rule: Requires authenticated external execution evidence from strong current systems on the same sealed unseen cases and materially comparable constraints. Repository-local labels, hashes, URLs, synthetic fixtures and self-attested booleans are insufficient.
comparative_evidence.level_6_rule: Requires independent end-to-end reproduction or validation in addition to Level 5 evidence.
comparative_evidence.level_7_rule: Requires continuing longitudinal frontier maintenance with refreshed baselines, failure retention, drift detection and governed replacement.

claims: No parity, superiority, global-frontier, world-best or five-calendar-year-leadership claim is authorized by repository-local CI alone. Such claims require the evidence level appropriate to the exact claim.
